binding: T001 self-assesses; T002 (independent) owns the binding class
cell_labels: unchanged segarecomp_ml_v3.cell_labels: any I -> positive, all D -> negative, otherwise masked

classes.PARTIAL: G1-G5 hold, positive cells >= 5% of cells, but U1, U2, U3 or C1 fails (usable with documented limitation)
classes.PROCEED: G1-G5 hold and U1, U2, U3 and C1 hold
classes.STOP: any of G1-G4 fails after at most one bounded correction cycle, or positive cells < 5% of cells

D: HW_HEADER: 0x000-0x1FF vector table and cartridge header
DMA: observed 68K-bus VDP DMA sources inside the image (control-port reconstruction; an extent overlapping accepted code is masked whole)

DR: observed CPU data reads by an accepted executed reader (or RAM code) that never reads accepted code outside its own fetch window, outside the 4-byte prefetch shadow after executed code and outside copy origins of RAM-executed code widened to the copier's contiguous read extent; disabled for the image when any non-trampoline RAM-executed run has no ROM origin
Ghidra veto: an ADR-0025 code-entry candidate inside data unlabels the next 10 bytes
I/c: E executed: MAME 0.276 trace of :maincpu, PC inside the image, m68k-disasm (walk decode at that PC, else traced) and the CPU-owned decoder agree on the length; odd PCs, disagreements and overlapping executed spans are masked

R static reach: direct Bcc/BRA/BSR/DBcc/JMP/JSR(abs.w|abs.l|d16(PC)) targets and fall-through of non-call/trap, non-terminating instructions (calls/traps only when the return site was executed), from accepted code, with m68k-disasm walk + CPU-owned decoder length agreement and no overlap
evidence_tiers.U: everything else; unknown is never a negative
excluded: Ghidra as a label source (veto/disagreement only)
sega2asm (not selected for the pilot: no gap it fills)

gates.G1_synthetic_soundness: 0 wrong I, c or D bytes on the committed synthetic cartridge vs its GNU as listing truth
gates.G2_determinism: both replicas of every scenario have identical PC, DMA and read digests
gates.G3_mapping: MAME ROM view equals the image (0 mismatched words) and no executed cartridge-space PC beyond the image
gates.G4_decoder_consistency: E rejections (no decode, CPU-decoder rejection, length disagreement, overlap) <= 2% of executed ROM PCs
gates.G5_reproduction: an independent validator (T002) re-runs label from the retained scenario evidence and obtains the same classes digest

report_metrics: qualified starts by tier (E/R) and continuation bytes
tool disagreement rates (E decode, Ghidra-in-data, DMA vs read-tap agreement, m68k-disasm walk instructions not admitted)
wall and CPU cost per stage
status: frozen before the first full Chuck Rock analysis
storage: <HARNESS_ROOT>/.cache/m68k-corpus/ (git-ignored; ADR 0151 retention); committed evidence is aggregate-only
